stem.text: A rope is attached to a sledge and a boy uses the rope to pull the sledge along a horizontal surface with a constant velocity. The tension in the rope is $100\,\text{N}$ and the rope is held at $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.

stem.alt: Diagram of a sledge on a horizontal surface with a rope pulled at 30 degrees to the horizontal, labelled 100 N, with the angle 30° marked.

stem.text: How much work does the boy do on the sledge when he pulls it a distance of $5.0\,\text{m}$ along the surface?
